title: Lumin Glen
safeHtml:
'''Lumin Glen''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is the Westernmost Sub-District of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-07.

History

The name of this Sub-District originates from the fact that this District features the most amount of land that is not within Snow-related Biome and gave an abundance of trees.

Due to the remoteness of this location, the Developer of Asylum has decided to build a large Public Estate of 31 separate Houses that is also divided into three phases for ease of administration, with a Shopping Mall at the center that is inspired by Queen's Hill Estate. Moreover, Lumin Glen also features a lot of recreational facilities, including a sports center and a swimming pool. This way, Lumin Glen residents would not have to worry about long travel times whenever they leave home.

As Lumin Glen does not feature any Private Housing, it also means that this Sub-District has the highest ratio of Public Housing and Public Estates.

On the other hand, while Nazca Railway's Mangkhut Sound Station is also built earlier, as the Full Name of that station is Mangkhut Sound, Nazca Railway needs to use MAS as the Station Code ('''MA'''ngkhut '''S'''ound), compounded with the fact that the Code MAN has never been used in Nazca Railway prior to this station, the Station Code for this station becomes MAN ('''MAN'''sgrove). In short:
  • For Nazca Railway, Mangkhut Sound Station's Code is MAS, and Mansgrove Station's Code is MAN;

title: Maritime Vista
safeHtml:
'''Maritime Vista''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Winsol. It is located at the East Side of North Winsol, and its District Code is 29-20.

History

The name of this Sub-District originates from the fact that the many tourists came to this area to look at waves despite the turbulent nature of the waves in the nearby vicinity which had claimed many lives.

Maritime Vista was not a part of the Asylum New Town, but as the developer of Asylum also began developing Winsol, the area in Winsol to the north of Route 18 is now seen as a part of Asylum New Town. Vermillion Stone is the east section of the Extension.
